# Karn HR Academy

> Free academic learning platform for HR & Management — structured study notes, expert video lectures, topic-wise MCQ quizzes, curated books, and previous year question papers for MBA, BBA, HR professionals, and UGC NET/JRF aspirants. Built by HR educator Nupur Karn. All content is free.

## Main Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview — disciplines, featured notes, lectures, books, and articles.
- [Study Notes](/notes): Downloadable, exam-aligned notes for every discipline, filterable by subject and topic.
- [MCQ Quizzes](/quizzes): Topic-wise practice quizzes with instant feedback, explanations, timers, and leaderboards.
- [Video Lectures](/lectures): Concept-clarity video lectures by HR academics.
- [Live Lectures](/live-lectures): Scheduled live teaching sessions.
- [UGC NET/JRF Labour Welfare](/ugc-net-labour-welfare): Flagship unit-wise study hub for UGC NET/JRF Paper II Labour Welfare / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations / HRM (Subject Code 55) — notes, MCQs, and previous year question papers organised across all 10 official units.
- [Blog](/blogs): In-depth articles on HR, management, and exam preparation.
- [Books](/books): Curated book recommendations with author notes.
- [Newspaper Highlights](/newspaper): Current-affairs highlights for aspirants.
- [Search](/search): Sitewide search across notes, quizzes, topics, and articles.
- [About](/about): About the educator and the mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.

## Disciplines Covered

- Human Resource Management (HRM) — notes at [/notes?subject=hrm](/notes?subject=hrm), topic pages under /hr/
- Organisational Behaviour (OB) — notes at [/notes?subject=ob](/notes?subject=ob), topic pages under /ob/
- Strategic Management (SM) — notes at [/notes?subject=sm](/notes?subject=sm), topic pages under /sm/
- Principles of Management (POM) — notes at [/notes?subject=pom](/notes?subject=pom), topic pages under /pom/
- Business Communication (BC) — notes at [/notes?subject=bc](/notes?subject=bc), topic pages under /bc/
- Organisation Development & Change Management (OD & CM) — notes at [/notes?subject=odcm](/notes?subject=odcm), topic pages under /odcm/
- International HRM — notes at [/notes?subject=ghr](/notes?subject=ghr), topic pages under /ghr/
- Labour Welfare (UGC NET/JRF) — full unit-wise hub at [/ugc-net-labour-welfare](/ugc-net-labour-welfare)
